newsitem.title: USA: CANTV names controller Schoenberger CFO.
newsitem.headline: CANTV names controller Schoenberger CFO.

text.p: Venezuela's CANTV said Tuesday that its chief financial officer, Andres Gluski, had been named executive vice president of planning and technology and that David Schoenberger, its former controller, would succeed Gluski as CFO.
CANTV said Kathleen Izaguirre, its former executive vice president of planning and technology, would lead corporate restructuring efforts.
CANTV, which is Venezuela's national telephone company, said Gluski would continue to lead its relations with international capital markets.
Additionally, it said Doug Mullen, formerly the president of its Caveguias directory unit, was named as executive vice president of marketing.
